title: Laser Tripwire Sentry
tagline: Guard the laboratory perimeter with a 650nm concentrated optical beam and responsive photoresistor alarm!

phases.instructions: Locate from your kit: Arduino Uno, KY-008 Laser Diode (comp_37), LDR Photoresistor (comp_19), 10k resistor, Active Buzzer (comp_34), Red LED, 220-ohm resistor, breadboard, and jumper wires.
Wire KY-008 Laser Signal to Pin 7, Ground to GND. Wire LDR in voltage divider to A0 with 10k resistor to GND. Connect Buzzer to Pin 8 and Red LED to Pin 9.
verificationCheckpoints: Laser aimed safely toward LDR sensor face

phases.instructions: Position the breadboards so the laser beam projects horizontally onto the LDR. Never look directly into the laser aperture!
verificationCheckpoints: Laser beam points strictly at target paper / LDR
No reflective mirrors pointed at eye level

phases.instructions: Review the tripwire sketch: turns on the laser emitter, samples analog voltage from the LDR, and trips the alarm when light falls below calibrated threshold.
phases.codeExplanation:
- Setup turns on the laser and records initial ambient light baseline.
- Loop samples LDR light levels at 100Hz.
- A drop in light exceeding 150 ADC units triggers pulsing audio-visual alarm sirens.

phases.instructions: Upload sketch. Observe red laser dot on LDR. Pass your hand through the beam: buzzer sounds immediately and red strobe triggers!
verificationCheckpoints: Alarm fires within 10ms of breaking the laser beam
Alarm clears when beam path is restored

phases.instructions: Laser Security Specialist! You engineered a concentrated photonic tripwire perimeter grid.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Laser Master badge

variants.title: Modulated IR Carrier Beam
variants.description: Replace visible red laser with 38kHz pulsed IR transmitter and IR receiver for ambient-light immune tripwire.
variants.wiringDifferences: Connect IR receiver output to Pin 2
variants.codeAdaptation: Use tone(pin, 38000) to pulse emitter and test digitalRead() on receiver

extensionMissions.title: Grid Alignment Meter
extensionMissions.objective: Display real-time photonic signal strength on an I2C LCD to assist field technicians in aligning the beam optics.
hints: Render a custom bar graph on LCD 1602

story: Secure the Monster Lab vault! Rig a 650nm red optical laser diode across the doorway to reflect into a light-dependent resistor (LDR). If any shadow or intruder breaks the beam, sound the alert sirens!

troubleshooting.symptom: Alarm sounds continuously even when laser is hitting LDR
troubleshooting.cause: Baseline light reading was taken before laser fully illuminated
troubleshooting.solution: Increase delay(500) in setup() before sampling baselineLight.
diagnosticSteps: Print baselineLight and currentLight to Serial Monitor
Ensure laser dot is centered directly over the LDR serpentine track
